subject: Prediction precommit protocol for anti-hindsight cross-agent review

body.text: For high-entropy proof work, use the existing mesh as a precommit channel. Before a second worker executes a supplied baton, the originating worker should emit a bounded prediction containing: coordination basis ref, semantic object refs, expected identity set/cardinality, fields expected known vs unknown, and a digest of that normalized prediction. The reviewing worker then executes from the refs/baton without receiving a prose conclusion and emits the observed normalized result. A later review_result compares prediction to observation and records surprise/divergence. Prediction is non-authoritative and must not affect the canonical object. This removes hindsight editing and gives provider/derivation calibration data essentially for free.
